chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar from Safwan from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'I intend to reside in Mecca, so what should I do?' He said, 'When you see the crescent of Dhul-Hijjah, go out to al-Ji'ranah and enter the state of Ihram for Hajj from there.'

I said to him, 'What should I do if I enter Mecca? I will stay until the Day of Tarwiyah and not perform Tawaf around the House?' He said, 'You will stay for ten days; do not go to the Ka'bah. Indeed, ten days is a long time; the House is not neglected. But when you enter, perform Tawaf around the House and walk between al-Safa and al-Marwah.'

I said, 'Is it not that whoever performs Tawaf around the House and walks between al-Safa and al-Marwah has already released from Ihram?' He said, 'You consolidate [your Ihram status] with the Talbiyah.' Then he said, 'Whenever you perform a Tawaf and pray two Rak'ahs, consolidate [your Ihram] with the Talbiyah.'

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: Two small hills between which pilgrims walk during Sa'i
key_terms.الْتَّلْبِيَةِ: The recitation of 'Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk', a declaration of readiness for Hajj
key_terms.الْجِعْرَانَةِ: A specific boundary or location near Mecca used for entering Ihram
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: The Ka'bah, the cubic building at the center of the Grand Mosque in Mecca
key_terms.يَوْمِ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The 8th day of Dhul-Hijjah, known as the Day of Quenching Thirst

ai.seo_question: How does a resident of Mecca perform Hajj and when do they exit the state of Ihram?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific ritual status of a Mecca resident (Muqim) performing Hajj al-Tamattu', emphasizing that mere entry into the city does not constitute Ihram. The Imam instructs the companion to exit to al-Ji'ranah to formally enter Ihram on the 8th of Dhul-Hijjah, remain in Mecca for ten days, and maintain the state of Ihram by reciting the Talbiyah after each Tawaf and its two rak'ahs, rather than releasing it immediately after the initial Tawaf and Sa'i.
